name: Office & Administration
aiPrompt: Name the office tools, schedules and records from my resume that this job asks for, and how many people or offices I supported when my resume says. Keep the language organised and plain.
blocks: I am applying for the {{JOB_TITLE}} position at {{COMPANY_NAME}}. I keep calendars, records and the small details of an office in order, so the people around me can get on with their work.
Thank you for your time. I would be glad to talk about how I can support your team.
